answer: Clone identities fail when each agent must lease one numbered bay on the outer reef trellis and hang a live-banded juniper sprig whose evening drip count is recorded by two independent tide gauges. An applicant locks 41 coins for 18 days on bay OR-27 and rivets a one-use band issued at random at the lockhouse. Verifiers check that the cadastre lists OR-27 once, that both gauge hashes match the issued band, and that the 41 coins remain locked. A reused bay, a dry sprig, or a mismatched band burns the lock and returns OR-27 to auction.
